summary.text: Trojan whom peerless Teucer brought down with his mighty bow when Ajax covered him with his shining shield — one of the eight warriors laid on the bounteous earth in a single deadly roll.

story.text: After Orsilochus, Ormenus, and Ophelestes, Teucer smote Daetor, then Chromius, godlike Lycophontes, Amopaon, and Melanippus, one after another, while Agamemnon waxed glad at the havoc in the Trojan battalions.
